name: When should I schedule finish painting during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I schedule finish painting during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish painting should typically be scheduled after all major construction, drywall installation, and significant carpentry work are completed, but before final fixtures and flooring are installed. This allows painters clear access to all surfaces and minimizes the risk of damage from other trades. Coordinating the painting schedule with your general contractor, like Frasheski Construction, is crucial to ensure a seamless transition and efficient project flow, avoiding delays or rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule finish painting after major construction and drywall are done, but before final fixtures, to ensure clear access and prevent damage.
